name: Tomcat Vault
tagline: Enterprise Cryptographic Credential Manager & DataSource Factory for Apache Tomcat Connection Pools.
description:
Enterprise-grade cryptographic credential manager, diagnostic verifier, and JNDI DataSource factory for Apache Tomcat connection pools. Eliminates cleartext database credentials from context.xml and server.xml using authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption.

Enterprise Infrastructure Hardening

🔐 Authenticated AES-256-GCM

Uses 256-bit AES in Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) with 12-byte random IVs and 128-bit authentication tags. Adopts ENC(...) envelopes while maintaining legacy backward compatibility.

🏊 Universal Connection Pools

Dedicated high-performance factories for HikariCP (VaultHikariDataSourceFactory), Tomcat DBCP2, Tomcat JDBC, Vibur DBCP, and C3P0.

🚀 Seamless JNDI Pool Configuration

Step 1: Configure Resource in context.xml
factory="umrao.tomcat.vault.VaultHikariDataSourceFactory"
password="ENC(AQIDBAUGBwgJCgsMDQ4PEBESExQ...)"
Step 2: Pre-Flight CLI Verification
java -jar tomcat-vault.jar --verify --context /conf/context.xml
